scaled_dynamic_scene_segmentation.description: Decomposed 4D instance segmentation of reduced kitchen-like dynamic scenes (one person handling objects, a pet, static furniture) from fixed linear-motion Gaussian primitives and independent per-image automatic masks; 5 hidden test scenes, scored in hidden test views over 60 frames.
scaled_dynamic_scene_segmentation.notes: Scaled substitute for the paper's Neural3DV / SelfCap evaluations (Table 1). Results are this gym's reference runs on the hidden test scenes; the paper's own full-scale numbers are kept under _paper_reported and are not on this scale.

mIoU.description: Mean per-instance IoU of rendered instance masks in held-out views over all frames (one prediction-to-instance matching per scene).

mAcc.description: Mean per-instance one-vs-rest pixel accuracy in held-out views.

Recall.description: Mean per-instance pixel recall in held-out views.

F1.description: Mean per-instance F1 (precision/recall) in held-out views.

Recalldyn.description: Recall averaged over instances that move during the sequence.

Recallstatic.description: Recall averaged over instances that stay static.

scaled_interaction_segmentation.description: Decomposed 4D instance segmentation of reduced multi-person interaction scenes (four people with contacts and a passed ball, two static objects) from the same kind of inputs; 5 hidden test scenes. Also hosts the paper's streaming ablation: a run must beat the fixed random-order artifact on F1 and dynamic recall here.
scaled_interaction_segmentation.notes: Scaled substitute for the paper's Multi-Human evaluation (Table 1) and its Juggle streaming ablation (Table 2). The random-order baseline values are the gym's fixed comparison artifact. Weighted 0.6 (vs 0.4 for the dynamic-scene experiment) because the paper's central claim, streaming propagation of identities through interactions, is demonstrated on Multi-Human and its Table 2 ablation.

_paper_reported.note: Values reported in the paper (Tables 1 and 2) at full scale on Neural3DV, Multi-Human and SelfCap. They are not on the scale of this gym's reduced procedural scenes and are kept for provenance only; they are not targets the gym must match.
